summary_en: Mandatory surveys, disclosures and regulatory files attached to a property.
summary_fr: Diagnostics obligatoires, informations acquéreur et dossiers réglementaires du bien.

tools.name: Check & Visit
tools.positioning: Inspection software combined with a field network — the report can be produced by their operator rather than by your staff.
tools.description: Check & Visit provides digital état des lieux and property visit software for French professionals, together with a network of field operators who can carry out the inspection on the manager's behalf, and 3D capture options attached to the same record.
tools.real_estate_use: For a manager with dispersed properties, the constraint on inspections is travel time, not software. Outsourcing the visit to a local operator while keeping the report in the same digital format lets a lettings team scale without hiring inspectors — and the attached 3D capture doubles as a marketing asset for the next letting.
features: Digital état des lieux with photographic evidence
Field operator network performing inspections on request
3D capture and virtual visit attached to the property record
Electronic signature and report generation
Portfolio dashboard for inspection status
Integration with management software

use_cases.job: Have inspections carried out on dispersed properties without hiring inspectors
Capture a 3D visit at the same appointment as the inspection

tools.name: Immopad
tools.positioning: Digital property inspections on tablet — état des lieux, delivery snagging and periodic visits in one app.
tools.description: Immopad is a French application for property inspections: entry and exit état des lieux, new-build delivery snagging, periodic visits and works acceptance, captured on tablet or phone with photos, signed on the spot and produced as a report.
tools.real_estate_use: The état des lieux is the document a deposit dispute turns on, and a paper one written in ballpoint rarely survives it. Capturing room by room with dated photographs and an on-the-spot signature changes the evidentiary position entirely. The same capture engine is used by developers for delivery snagging, where the list of reserves has the same contentious quality.
features: Entry and exit état des lieux with photo evidence
Comparison between entry and exit condition
New-build delivery snagging and reserve tracking
On-site signature by both parties
Periodic and works acceptance visits
Report generation and archiving

use_cases.job: Produce an état des lieux that survives a deposit dispute
Record and track delivery reserves at handover of a new-build unit

tools.name: LICIEL
tools.positioning: The software French property diagnosticians produce their regulated reports in.
tools.description: LICIEL publishes software for the French diagnostic immobilier profession: DPE energy performance, asbestos, lead, gas, electricity, termites, surface measurement and the assembled dossier de diagnostic technique, with report generation, on-site capture and transmission to the required registries.
tools.real_estate_use: No French property can be sold or let without its diagnostic file, and the DPE in particular now carries legal consequences — a G-rated dwelling cannot be let. The diagnostician's software has to produce a report conforming to the current method and transmit it to the ADEME registry; when the method changes, the software is what has to change with it.
features: Report production for every regulated French diagnostic
DPE calculation following the current regulatory method
On-site capture on tablet with photos and measurements
Assembly of the dossier de diagnostic technique
Transmission to official registries
Client, mission and invoicing management

use_cases.job: Produce a regulation-compliant DPE and transmit it to the official registry
Obtain a complete diagnostic file before a mandate goes on the market

tools.name: Startloc
tools.positioning: État des lieux software priced for the individual landlord, not just the agency.
tools.description: Startloc is a French application for producing entry and exit état des lieux on phone or tablet: guided room-by-room capture, photographs, electronic signature by both parties and PDF report generation, sold at a per-inspection or subscription price accessible to individuals.
tools.real_estate_use: The private landlord doing their own inspection is exactly the person most exposed at exit, because their entry document is usually thin. A guided capture forces completeness — every room, every element, dated photographs — and the signed PDF is what the deposit deduction will rest on if the tenant contests it.
features: Guided room-by-room inspection capture
Photographic evidence attached to each element
Electronic signature by landlord and tenant on site
Entry-to-exit comparison
PDF report generation and storage
Meter reading and key handover recording

use_cases.job: Produce a complete entry inspection that supports a later deposit deduction
Run inspections on a phone without buying an agency-grade platform
